newsitem.title: CANADA: Tarxien board approves circular. [CORRECTED 16:04 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Tarxien board approves circular. [CORRECTED 16:04 GMT]

text.p: Auto parts maker Tarxien Corp said its board of directors approved and delivered a directors' circular in response to a C$14.10 a share takeover offer by Gecamex Acquisitions Inc, a unit of Gecamex Technologies Inc.
(Corrects headline and first paragraph to clarify that board approving circular, not takeover offer)
But the board said it advised shareholders not to tender their shares to Gecamex until they received more communication from the board.

Tarxien has also received takeover bids from privately held PaintPlas for C$14.50 a common share in cash and Ventra Group Inc. Ventra raised its offer to C$9.25 a share plus Ventra shares and warrants from C$8 a share plus two Ventra shares for each Tarxien share. Ventra sweetened its offer in response to the Gecamex offer.
Tarxien's board also said it had been unable to review any information from the PaintPlas offer or the second notice of change mailed by Ventra.
